dumm.et:
From Middle High German tump, from Old High German tumb, from Proto-West Germanic *dumb, from Proto-Germanic *dumbaz, from Proto-Indo-European *dʰewbʰ-.
The modern consonantism is Central and Low German (compare Middle Low German dumb, dumm, from Old Saxon dum…

s: airhead, birdbrain, bubblehead, feather-brain, featherhead, jingle-brains, lamebrain, peabrain, pinhead
Mit der Dummheit kämpfen Götter selbst vergebens.
Against stupidity, the gods themselves contend in vain.

dumpf.et: Gradation from Middle High German dimpfen (“to smoke, fume”), and related to Dampf (“steam”), see there for more. English dank has been speculated to be related.

s: to be tied up bobbing up and down in the water
Unser Boot dümpelte am Ufer des flachen Weihers.
Our boat was bobbing at the shore of the shallow pond.
to be stuck; to be inactive or unsuccessful; to make no substantial progress
Der Klub dümpelt seit Jahren in der 5. Liga.
The club has been stuck in the 5th division for years.
dümpeln.et: Via German Low German from Middle Low German dümpelen. Probably related to Tümpel (“shallow pond”). Cognate with Dutch dompelen.

s: audacious, reckless (impudent, stupid, inappropriate through lacking consideration); generally of speech or social behaviour, not dangerous acts
Es war schon dummdreist, den Richter in der Pause zu fragen, was ein Freispruch kosten würde.
It was audacious to ask the judge during the break how much it would cost to be acquitted.
dummdreist.et: Borrowed from the Middle Low German compound dumdrīste, in which dum (dumm) did not mean "stupid" but rather "reckless". Later interpreted more literally as dumm + dreist, literally “dumb-brash”.

s: duma (lower house of the Federal Assembly of Russia)
stupid people tend to be full of themselves
Dummheit und Stolz wachsen auf einem Hol.et: Literally, “stupidity and pride grow from the same tree”

s: airhead, birdbrain, bubblehead, feather-brain, featherhead, jingle-brains, lamebrain, peabrain, pinhead
Dummbatz.et: From dumm + Batz. Compare to dumbass.

s: thick as a brick, dumb as a box of rocks

Dummerjan.et: Univerbation of dummer + Jan, literally “stupid John” (16th century). The optionally lengthened vowel as well as the byform above are due to influence of Grobian, Schlendrian (of different formation).

s: less intelligent people make for a better sexual experience

「蠢鹅，」老太婆说，「炉口够大了，你看，连我自己都进得去。」她一边说一边爬过去，把头伸进了烤炉。

Nachdem sie ihr Hausvieh zuerst dumm gemacht haben und sorgfältig verhüteten, daß diese ruhigen Geschöpfe ja keinen Schritt außer dem Gängelwagen, darin sie sie einsperreten, wagen durften, so zeigen sie ihnen nachher die Gefahr, die ihnen drohet, wenn sie es versuchen, allein zu gehen.
他们先是把自己的家畜弄得愚笨，又小心翼翼地防止这些温顺的生灵敢于迈出那把它们关在里面的学步车哪怕一步；然后再向它们指出：一旦尝试独自行走，就会有危险威胁它们。
